verses.sloka: कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम् ।व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.६८.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kathāṁ kathayatāṁ teṣāṁ jayaṁ cākāṅkṣatāṁ śubham ।vyatītā rajanī śīghraṁ śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.68.1 ॥

translations.english: While they were conversing and wishing for an auspicious victory, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रभाते विमले तस्मिन्काले स राक्षसः ।निर्गतस्तु पुराद्धीरो भक्ष्याहारप्रचोदितः ।। ७.६८.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale tasminkāle sa rākṣasaḥ ।nirgatastu purāddhīro bhakṣyāhārapracoditaḥ ।। 7.68.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, in that clear morning, the brave demon, impelled by his hunger for food, came out of the city.
translations.hindi: पत्तरिफेर्मिड हे रघुनाथ जी ! देवताओं के समस्त ( अर्थात्‌ रेबताओं के आदरभाजन ) वे राजा और वसिष्ठ जी देहहीन हो कर, क्यों कर फिर शरीरघारी हुए ?

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः शत्रुघ्नो यमुनां नदीम् ।तीर्त्वा मधुपुरद्वारि धनुष्पाणिरतिष्ठत ।। ७.६८.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vīraḥ śatrughno yamunāṁ nadīm ।tīrtvā madhupuradvāri dhanuṣpāṇiratiṣṭhata ।। 7.68.3 ॥

translations.english: In the meantime, the brave Shatrughna, having crossed the Yamuna river, stood at the gate of Madhupura with his bow in hand.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते क्रूरकर्मा स राक्षसः ।आगच्छद्बहुसाहस्रं प्राणिनां भारमुद्वहन् ।। ७.६८.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte krūrakarmā sa rākṣasaḥ ।āgacchadbahusāhasraṁ prāṇināṁ bhāramudvahan ।। 7.68.4 ॥

translations.english: Then, as midday arrived, that cruel demon came, carrying the burden of many thousands of living beings.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! वे दोनों धर्मात्मा आपस के शाप के कारण देहों . को त्याग कर, तपस्वी ब्रह्मर्षि वसिष्ठ जी और राजा निमि वायुरूप हो गए (अर्थात्‌ स्थूल शारीर त्याग, सूच्म शरारधारी हो गए)

verses.sloka: ततो ददर्श शत्रुघ्नं स्थितं द्वारि धृतायुधम् ।तमुवाच ततो रक्षः किमनेन करिष्यसि ।। ७.६८.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato dadarśa śatrughnaṁ sthitaṁ dvāri dhṛtāyudham ।tamuvāca tato rakṣaḥ kimanena kariṣyasi ।। 7.68.5 ॥

translations.english: Then he saw Shatrughna standing at the gate, holding a weapon, and the demon then asked him, "What will you do with this?"
translations.hindi: हे प्रभो ! देह न होने से बड़ा कष्ट है । क्योंकि देह रहने ही से सब काम किए जा सकते हैं। अथवा देहहीन मनुष्य कुछ भी नहीं कर सकता

verses.sloka: ईदृशानां सहस्राणि सायुधानां नराधम ।भक्षितानि मया रोषात्कालमाकाङ्क्षसे नु किम् ।। ७.६८.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśānāṁ sahasrāṇi sāyudhānāṁ narādhama ।bhakṣitāni mayā roṣātkālamākāṅkṣase nu kim ।। 7.68.6 ॥

translations.english: "O vilest of men, I have devoured thousands of armed individuals like you out of anger; do you indeed desire death?"
translations.hindi: वहाँ जा, घर्मज्ञ एवं वायुभूत सूच्सरारीरधारी वशिष्ठ जी देब-देच ब्रह्मा जी के चरणों में सीस नवा प्रणाम कर उनसे इस प्रकार बोले

verses.sloka: आहारश्चास्य सम्पूर्णो ममायं पुरुषाधम ।स्वयं प्रविष्टो ऽद्य मुखं कथमासाद्य दुर्मते ।। ७.६८.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: āhāraścāsya sampūrṇo mamāyaṁ puruṣādhama ।svayaṁ praviṣṭo 'dya mukhaṁ kathamāsādya durmate ।। 7.68.7 ॥

translations.english: The demon, addressing Shatrughna, exclaims that Shatrughna, the vilest and evil-minded of men, has today entered his mouth by himself, thus becoming his complete meal.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌! मैं निभि के शाप से (स्थूल) शरीर रहित हो रहा हूँ । हे अण्डज ! हे देवदेव! हे महादेव ! में वायुभूत ( सूच्मशरीरधारी ) हो रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: तस्यैवं भाषमाणस्य हसतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ।शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो रोषादश्रूण्यवासृजत् ।। ७.६८.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṁ bhāṣamāṇasya hasataśca muhurmuhuḥ ।śatrughno vīryasampanno roṣādaśrūṇyavāsṛjat ।। 7.68.8 ॥

translations.english: As the demon spoke thus and laughed repeatedly, the valiant Shatrughna shed tears out of intense anger.

verses.sloka: तस्य रोषाभिभूतस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।तेजोमया मरीच्यस्तु सर्वगात्रैर्विनिष्पतन् ।। ७.६८.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya roṣābhibhūtasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।tejomayā marīcyastu sarvagātrairviniṣpatan ।। 7.68.9 ॥

translations.english: From the great-souled Shatrughna, who was overcome by such rage, radiant rays of light emanated from all his limbs.

verses.sloka: उवाच च सुसङ्क्रुद्धः शत्रुघ्नस्तं निशाचरम् ।योद्धुमिच्छामि दुर्बुद्धे द्वन्द्वयुद्धं त्वया सह ।। ७.६८.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca susaṅkruddhaḥ śatrughnastaṁ niśācaram ।yoddhumicchāmi durbuddhe dvandvayuddhaṁ tvayā saha ।। 7.68.10 ॥

translations.english: And Shatrughna, greatly enraged, spoke to that demon, declaring his wish to engage in single combat with the evil-minded one.
translations.hindi: हे महायशस्त्री ! तुम मित्रावरुण के वाये में प्रवेश करो । हे द्विज- रेष्ठ ! वहाँ भी तुम अयोनिज रहोगे (अथ! त्‌ किसी खनी की योनि से PUSSIES SSS SR १ मेवशम्‌ - मदधीनतां । ( गो० ) ५ पाठान्तरे-- लोकनाथ महादेव ्रण्डजोपि त्वमव्जजः |” ५८६ उत्तरकाण उत्पन्न न होगे) ओर धमं से युक्त हो कर, फिर मेरे ही अधीन होगे

verses.sloka: पुत्रो दशरथस्याहं भ्राता रामस्य धीमतः ।शत्रुघ्नो नित्यशत्रुघ्नो वधाकाङ्क्षी तवागतः ।। ७.६८.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: putro daśarathasyāhaṁ bhrātā rāmasya dhīmataḥ ।śatrughno nityaśatrughno vadhākāṅkṣī tavāgataḥ ।। 7.68.11 ॥

translations.english: I am Shatrughna, the son of Dasharatha and brother of the wise Rama, the eternal slayer of enemies, and I have come here desiring your death.
translations.hindi: जब लोकपितामह ब्रह्मा जी ने ऐसा कहा, तत्र उनको प्रणाम कर तथा उनकी परिक्रमा कर, वसिष्ठ जी तुरन्त वरुणलोक में गए

verses.sloka: तस्य मे युद्धकामस्य द्वन्द्वयुद्धं प्रदीयताम् ।शत्रुस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां न मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि ।। ७.६८.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya me yuddhakāmasya dvandvayuddhaṁ pradīyatām ।śatrustvaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ na me jīvangamiṣyasi ।। 7.68.12 ॥

translations.english: Grant me, who desires battle, a single combat, for you are an enemy to all beings, and you shall not escape me alive.
translations.hindi: उस समय मित्र ( सूये) भी वरुण-सहित समस्त देवताओं से पूज्य हो कर, वरुण के राज्य का शासन कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव ।प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि दुर्मते ।। ७.६८.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmiṁstathā bruvāṇe tu rākṣasaḥ prahasanniva ।pratyuvāca naraśreṣṭhaṁ diṣṭyā prāpto 'si durmate ।। 7.68.13 ॥

translations.english: As he spoke thus, the demon, as if laughing, replied to the best of men, "Fortunately, O evil-minded one, you have arrived!"

verses.sloka: मम मातृष्वसुर्भ्राता रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।हतो रामेण दुर्बुद्धे स्त्रीहेतोः पुरुषाधम ।। ७.६८.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: mama mātṛṣvasurbhrātā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।hato rāmeṇa durbuddhe strīhetoḥ puruṣādhama ।। 7.68.14 ॥

translations.english: O foolish one, O lowest of men, my maternal uncle Ravana, the lord of demons, was killed by Rama for the sake of a woman.
translations.hindi: करुणालय में अर्थात्‌ समुद्र के तट पर उस रूपयौवन सम्पन्न उवेशी को क्रीड़ा.करते देख कर, वरुण ने हर्षित हो कर चाहा कि उसके साथ प्रीति ( अर्थात्‌ मैथुन ) करें

verses.sloka: तच्च सर्वं मया क्षान्तं रावणस्य कुलक्षयम् ।अवज्ञां पुरतः कृत्वा मया यूयं विशेषतः ।। ७.६८.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacca sarvaṁ mayā kṣāntaṁ rāvaṇasya kulakṣayam ।avajñāṁ purataḥ kṛtvā mayā yūyaṁ viśeṣataḥ ।। 7.68.15 ॥

translations.english: I tolerated all that, the destruction of Ravana's lineage, but I have especially shown contempt towards you all from the very beginning.

verses.sloka: निहताश्च हि मे सर्वे परिभूतास्तृणं यथा ।भूताश्चैव भविष्याश्च यूयं च पुरुषाधमाः ।। ७.६८.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: nihatāśca hi me sarve paribhūtāstṛṇaṁ yathā ।bhūtāścaiva bhaviṣyāśca yūyaṁ ca puruṣādhamāḥ ।। 7.68.16 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, all of them, past, present, and future, including you, O lowest of men, have been killed and insulted by me as if they were mere grass.
translations.hindi: तब बह अप्सरा हाथ जोड़ कर वरुण जी से बोली-हे सुरेश्वर ! मित्र देवता ने पडले ही से मुकसे कह रखा है अथवा ` मित्र देवता के साथ में पहिले ही प्रतिज्ञा कर चुकी हूँ

verses.sloka: तस्य ते युद्धकामस्य युद्धं दास्यामि दुर्मते ।तिष्ठं त्वं च मुहूर्तं तु यावदायुधमानये ।ईप्सितं यादृशं तुभ्यं सज्जये यावदायुधम् ।। ७.६८.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya te yuddhakāmasya yuddhaṁ dāsyāmi durmate ।tiṣṭhaṁ tvaṁ ca muhūrtaṁ tu yāvadāyudhamānaye ।īpsitaṁ yādṛśaṁ tubhyaṁ sajjaye yāvadāyudham ।। 7.68.17 ॥

translations.english: O evil-minded one, I will give you the battle you desire; just wait for a moment until I bring and prepare the kind of weapon you wish for.
translations.hindi: यह सुन काम से पीड़ित बरुण जी ने कहा--यदि यही बात हे तो मैं, तुमे देख कर छुब्ध होने के कारण, अपने वीय को इस देवनिर्भित घड़े में छोड़े देता हूँ

verses.sloka: तमुवाचाशु शत्रुघ्नः क्व मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि ।शत्रुर्यदृच्छया दृष्टो न मोक्तव्यः कृतात्मना ।। ७.६८.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamuvācāśu śatrughnaḥ kva me jīvangamiṣyasi ।śatruryadṛcchayā dṛṣṭo na moktavyaḥ kṛtātmanā ।। 7.68.18 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna quickly said to him, "Where will you go alive from me? An enemy, once seen by chance, should not be released by a resolute person."
translations.hindi: हे सुन्दर. नितंबोंबाली ! यदि तू मेरे साथ मैथुन करना नही चाहती तो में इस घट में वीय छोड़ अपनी कामभोग की लालसाः को पूरी कर लूँगा

verses.sloka: यो हि विक्लवया बुद्ध्या प्रसरं शत्रवे ददौ ।स हतो मन्दबुद्धित्वाद्यथा कापुरुषस्तथा ।। ७.६८.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo hi viklavayā buddhyā prasaraṁ śatrave dadau ।sa hato mandabuddhitvādyathā kāpuruṣastathā ।। 7.68.19 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, whoever gives an advantage to an enemy with a wavering mind is killed due to his dull-wittedness, just like a coward.

verses.sloka: तस्मात्सुदृष्टं कुरु जीवलोकं शरैः शितैस्त्वां विविधैर्नयामि ।यमस्य गेहाभिमुखं हि पापं रिपुं त्रिलोकस्य च राघवस्य ।। ७.६८.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmātsudṛṣṭaṁ kuru jīvalokaṁ śaraiḥ śitaistvāṁ vividhairnayāmi ।yamasya gehābhimukhaṁ hi pāpaṁ ripuṁ trilokasya ca rāghavasya ।। 7.68.20 ।।

translations.english: Therefore, take a good look at the world of the living, for I shall lead you, a sinful enemy of the three worlds and of Rama, towards Yama's abode with various sharp arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 68 ।। Thus ends the sixty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
